oncall-bot: Pager: P2 - inference-gateway 5xx spike (incident id: INC-2026-0421). Paging primary oncall. Customers: partner-billing, search-proxy. See /incidents/INC-2026-0421
Alex G: picking this up, starting triage. quick status: are errors across both regions?
Maya R: heads-up — I’m on a client call for the next 25m, can’t be primary. I can shadow if needed after 20:00 UTC.
Alex G: ok noted. @Jordan K are you available to take primary for the next 40m? I’ll handoff if you can.
Jordan K: I can take primary for 30m but I have a partial deploy at 20:10 UTC — need to be back by 20:35. fine to take now and handback before deploy.
Alex G: thanks. handing primary to Jordan now. Jordan, runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-gateway-5xx
Alex G: runbook quick checks:
```bash
# check gateway error rate
kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-gateway --tail 200 | grep "5.." | wc -l
# upstream health
curl -sS https://upstream-lb.internal/health | jq .
```
Jordan K: running checks. error rate looks elevated only for long-tail requests >15s. prefix cache shows miss spike. KV cache TTL seems shorter on a subset of pods.
Sam T: FYI I saw a related deploy earlier for model-quantization that bumped memory usage on a few nodes. Could be OOM eviction cascade.
Jordan K: good catch. Alex — do we want to fail open to fallback model group to reduce latency while we RC the cache issue?
Alex G: yes, initiate fallback to model-group:stable->model-group:fast-fp16 on the routing policy. That should cut tail latency.
Alex G: command to toggle route (runbook snippet):
```json
{
  "route_id": "inference-route-01",
  "fallback": "model-group:fast-fp16",
  "activate": true
}
```
Maya R: tagging in case access needed: @Sam T can you watch the autoscaler and pod restarts? I can help validate after my call.
Sam T: watching. I see 3 pods with restarts in last 5m, nodes show memory pressure. scaling not triggered yet because HPA target based on CPU.
Jordan K: I triggered fallback. Confirming streaming latency down to 120ms p50 and tail improving. Customers reported fewer errors via alerting.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status update: fallback applied at 2026-04-21T19:14:03Z. Error rate decreased by 68% in 5m window.
Alex G: nice. we still need a permanent fix — open a follow-up ticket to align HPA with memory or add memory-based scaling, and audit quantization deploy knobs.
Jordan K: created ticket RED-5472: "HPA memory metric + audit quantization deploy" and added checklist. Assigning to infra-team.
Maya R: back from the call. happy to shadow for the remainder and take back at 20:40 if needed.
Alex G: handback plan: Jordan will remain primary until 20:30, then I will shadow and take over if stable. if issues recur, escalate to infra oncall. Running notes saved under /incidents/INC-2026-0421/notes.
Sam T: monitoring autoscaler, will post if scaling triggers or more restarts.
Jordan K: quick postmortem note: prefix cache TTL misconfig on 3 pods; quantization deploy reduced headroom, causing memory churn. Will include detailed repro steps in RED-5472.
Alex G: thanks everyone. closing pager for primary swap. :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Pager resolved for primary oncall swap. Thread will auto-archive in 7 days.
